annotations.title: Redirect checker, URL unshortener: the full redirect chain

description: Follow a URL's redirects hop by hop (up to 10) and return every hop's status code and Location, the final URL, total hops, timing and whether it loops. Expands short links (bit.ly, t.co…) to their destination without loading the page. Every hop is checked before it is requested; redirects to private addresses are reported, not followed. Use to unshorten a link, check an HTTPS or www redirect, or debug SEO redirect chains. Example: url=http://github.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
